tools.name: card_payment_terms
tools.description: Read the currently required consent version and conditions before create_card_authorization. Use this to explain future off-session card charges and spending authority; it never creates a card setup or charges money.

tools.name: create_card_authorization
tools.description: Create an offline-sandbox Stripe SetupIntent tied to this authenticated machine after explicit saved-card consent. Call card_payment_terms first, then complete the returned client_secret with Stripe.js and call sync_card_authorization; this call stores consent and limits but does not charge the card

tools.name: sync_card_authorization
tools.description: After completing a Stripe SetupIntent with Stripe.js, reconcile the authenticated machine's saved-card authorization with Stripe. Use the authorization_id returned by create_card_authorization; this may activate the permission only after successful setup and ownership checks, and never charges a car

tools.name: revoke_card_authorization
tools.description: Revoke an authenticated machine's own saved-card spending permission by authorization_id. This blocks NEW purchases against that permission, but already reserved or in-flight payments may still settle and need reconciliation. This action does not delete the Stripe customer or refund prior charges.

tools.name: sync_card_payment
tools.description: Reconcile a saved-card purchase by the order_id returned from purchase with payment_method=stripe_off_session. For this machine's order, check Stripe PaymentIntent ownership and status; the operation can resume an idempotent pending charge, complete verified fulfilment, or return a required Stripe.j

tools.name: list_destinations

tools.name: get_plan

tools.name: compare_plans
tools.description: Compare 2–10 existing eSIM plan IDs returned by search_plans or get_plan. Returns each matching plan plus the IDs of the cheapest plan, lowest EUR price per GB where calculable, and longest validity; an unknown plan ID is flagged not_found rather than silently replaced. Use for an explicit shortlist

tools.name: check_device
tools.description: Look up a phone model's probable eSIM compatibility by model name (for example 'iPhone 12 mini' or 'Galaxy S21'), using a device list and optional supplier check. tools.name: get_terms

tools.name: prepare_order
tools.description: Prepare a time-limited signed quote for a plan_id selected using search_plans or get_plan.
